data.name: Erentis, l'académie de magie
data.detailed_description:
Become a Wizard Apprentice at Erentis Academy

Welcome to Erentis, a magical academy where your journey is just beginning.

In a colorful and distinctive 2D world, explore a fantastical universe, meet its inhabitants, develop your powers, and forge your own adventure.

A Single-Player RPG with a Community at Its Heart

Erentis is first and foremost a single-player adventure: progress at your own pace, explore the world, and develop your character without having to rely on a group.

But the world doesn't stop at your own adventure. Meet other players, trade, exchange, share your discoveries, and, if you wish, join or create a guild.

Choose Your Elemental Path

Air, Water, Fire, or Earth: choose your affinity and master the magic that suits you.

Each element offers three unique specializations, allowing you to build a character that matches your playstyle. Turn-based battles will put your strategy, planning, and anticipation to the test.

Explore a Living World

Travel across four territories, each with its own atmosphere and secrets to uncover.

Meet colorful characters, build relationships with them, and make choices throughout your conversations. Some encounters may hold more surprises than you expect...

Gather, Craft, and Develop Your Skills

The adventure is about more than just combat.

Herbalism, alchemy, cooking, enchanting, healing, and other professions allow you to develop different skills and create a wide variety of items.

Explore dungeons with ever-changing paths, gather resources, and craft your own equipment to prepare your character for new challenges.

An Independent, Free, and Accessible Adventure

Erentis is completely free to play and contains no advertising.

Play in your browser or on Steam, on PC or smartphone. The game is designed to run on a wide range of devices.

New features, improvements, and content are regularly added to expand the adventure.

An Adventure That Keeps Growing

Erentis already offers more than 30 hours of single-player content, including a main story, side quests, character progression, exploration, and secrets to uncover.

And the adventure doesn't end there: the world of Erentis continues to evolve with regular updates.

🔒 Protecting Your Data

Erentis is an online game, and the security and protection of your personal data are a priority.

We believe in transparency regarding the data we collect and how it is used.

👉 Read our privacy policy:

Join the Academy. Magic Awaits.
